Doctoral Admission Requirements for BME
Admission to the Biomedical Engineering Doctoral Program requires a BS or MS degree in a related field preferably in engineering. Leveling courses may be prescribed for applicants with other majors than BME, depending on their degree. In addition, the following items are required:
A minimum 3.0 GPA and
Where English is not the principal language, a minimum TOEFL score of: 550 on the paper based test, 213 on the computer based test, and 80 on the internet based test.
GRE Scores will also be considered for all applicants.
